// diagnostic E0642

Jet.RunDefaultWritten

This call passes `{name}`, which the build computes for each call

What

This call passes `{name}`, which the build computes for each call

Why

The default of `{name}` is written `#run`, so its value comes from this call's other arguments while building, and a written value could disagree with them.

Fix

Leave `{name}` out, or pass a parameter of your own function whose default is the same `#run` default.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.RunDefaultWritten: Tests/UI/run_default_written.stderr.

Error: Jet.RunDefaultWritten: This call passes `twice`, which the build computes for each call
  --> Tests/UI/run_default_written.jet:11:30
    |
 11 | run: fn() { print(scaled(20, 7)) }
    |                              ^
 Why: The default of `twice` is written `#run`, so its value comes from this call's other arguments while building, and a written value could disagree with them.
 Fix: Leave `twice` out, or pass a parameter of your own function whose default is the same `#run` default.
